notes:
Lead profile: small edtech startup focused on teacher-facing copilots and classroom workflows. Inbound via signup — trial keys used for basic prototype.

Key decision makers: Tom Alvarez (Head of Product), Priya Nambiar (CTO), Michael Reed (Director of Curriculum).

Pain / needs:
- Need robust moderation pipeline for student submissions (K-12) — automated filters + human escalation flows.
- Classroom copilot: short-turn prompts, context window from lesson + student history, streaming answers to UI.
- Function-calling / structured outputs: want grade signals and rubric metadata returned as JSON to push back to LMS.
- Cost sensitive: target < $0.02 active-student/day; current OpenAI PoC ran ~ $0.08/day — unsustainable.
- Latency: aiming for median <200ms for short prompts (under 256 tokens), burst to support 50 concurrent students per class.
- Integration: Google Classroom + roster sync; SAML SSO for teachers; optional KMS for keys.
- Data controls: prefer US-only residency, 30-day retention, ability to purge per-student data.

Quote from Tom: "If we can keep per-student costs predictable and add simple moderation baked in, we can move from pilot to district sales."

POC ask: 2-week hosted API trial with token usage estimate, example batching configs, and a small sample of streaming + function-calling demo. Want pricing worksheet that maps tokens -> daily per-student cost.

References: pricing deck link (drive), security FAQ link (drive), Fireflies call ff_20260203_sfx-01 (transcript requested).
